detail: tests.test_native_topic_local.NativeTopicLocalTest.test_history_reopens_and_survives_compaction (env FN_RUN_TOPIC_LOCAL_E2E, never run by a gate before lane b-control-optins): after two `operator store compact` runs on a stopped store, the offline `log scan-store` (tests/native_log_observation.py:66 committed_history) exits 4: `store: extent incarnation refused: READ-RESOURCES-UNAVAILABLE`. The same scan-store succeeded four times earlier in the test, before the compactions. The refusal is raised at host/native/extent.lisp:165 (fnn-extent-register) when fn-owner-page-file-issue returns :read-resources-unavailable (the 403 of books/owner-resource-line.lisp) instead of :issued or :unfunded-offline. Box evidence: hbox /tank/fn/scratch/b-control-optins/native-optins-2b6c0fca0/logs/test-tests.test_native_topic_local.log (lane head 2b6c0fca0, images of 919a41a17). Mechanism (M28, traced on dev c671cc263): fnn-command-log-scan-store (host/native/io.lisp:9804) loads the checkpoint through fnn-state-checkpoint-load, which registers the image via fnn-extent-register-at -> fnn-extent-register (extent.lisp:153) without first entering the pool's offline context (fnn-extent-pool-open-context, extent.lisp:305); fn-prp-mode stays :uninitialized, fn-owner-page-read-direct-mode answers :read-resources-unavailable and fn-owner-page-file-issue refuses (host/page-read-host.lisp:104-112). Before a compaction there is no checkpoint, so nothing registers. Introduced when stage-0's pool-context rule (ef55ef010, 10-01) required the context before any registration; scan-store (f577f7884, 09-29) predates it, and the other offline readers got the call (io.lisp:4408, :6297, :6978). Fix: enter the context before the checkpoint load as fnn-open-live-store does, and assert the scan's output in the test. Owner L (a durable-log verb), transferred from M by B25 on M28's trace.
source: B25 qualifying run for the control run's functional opt-ins (optin-e84056ca5, optins-2b6c0fca0)
title: offline log scan-store refuses READ-RESOURCES-UNAVAILABLE after store compaction
